title: Effects and mechanisms of frehmaglutin D and rehmaionoside C improve LPS-induced acute kidney injury through the estrogen receptor-mediated TLR4 pathway in vivo and in vitro.
authors: Liu, Meng; Guo, Pengli; Zeng, Mengnan; Zhang, Yuhan; Jia, Jufang; Liu, Yanling; Chen, Xu; Kuang, Haixue; Feng, Weisheng; Zheng, Xiaoke
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物通过雌激素受体-TLR4通路改善脓毒症急性肾损伤，涉及分子对接和蛋白互作，但核心是炎症疾病机制而非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Sepsis-induced acute kidney injury (S-AKI) is an inflammatory disease with sex differences and there has no effective drugs to cure it. Frehmaglutin D (Fre D) and rehmaionoside C (Reh C) are two violetone compounds with estrogenic activity isolated from Rehmannia glutinosa. However, whether these two drugs exert protective effects on S-AKI through their estrogen-like activity are unclear. PURPOSE: This study aimed to explore the effects and mechanisms of Fre D and Reh C on lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced S-AKI through the estrogen receptor pathway in vivo and in vitro and to explore the interaction between ER and TLR4 for the first time. METHODS: The LPS-induced female BALB/c mice S-AKI mouse model was established by adding the estrogen receptor antagonist ICI182,780. Renal function, inflammation, oxidative stress, apoptosis, immune cells, and expression of key proteins of the ER-TLR4-IL-1beta pathway were tested. The affinity of Fre D and Reh C for the ER was investigated by molecular docking. Then, an in vitro S-AKI model was established, and ERalpha/ERbeta antagonists (MPP/PHTPP) were added and combined with gene overexpression techniques. The interaction between ER and TLR4 was further explored by Co-IP, GST pull-down and SPR techniques. RESULTS: Fre D and Reh C ameliorated LPS-induced renal damage, inflammation in mice, regulated the immune cells, decreased ROS levels, increased ERalpha and ERbeta protein expression, and decreased TLR4, caspase 11 and IL-1beta protein expression. These effects were blocked by ICI182,780. Molecular docking results showed that Fre D and Reh C bound ERalpha and ERbeta with similar potency. The results of in vitro suggested that Fre D and Reh C reduced the levels of inflammation, ROS and apoptosis, TLR4, caspase 11, and IL-1beta protein expression and increased ERalpha/ERbeta protein expression in cells. All of these effects were reversed by the addition of MPP/PHTPP and further enhanced after ERalpha/ERbeta gene overexpression with no significant difference in effects. Moreover, there was an indirect or direct interaction between ER and TLR4, and the binding of ERalpha and ERbeta to TLR4 was concentration dependent. CONCLUSION: Fre D and Reh C may improve S-AKI through the ER-TLR4-IL-1beta pathway and may act on both ERalpha and ERbeta receptors. Moreover, ERalpha and ERbeta may interact directly or indirectly with TLR4, which was studied for the first time.
abstract_zh: 背景：脓毒症诱导的急性肾损伤（S-AKI）是一种具有性别差异的炎症性疾病，目前尚无有效治疗药物。地黄苷D（Fre D）和地黄苷C（Reh C）是从地黄（Rehmannia glutinosa）中分离出的两种具有雌激素活性的环烯醚萜类化合物。然而，这两种药物是否通过其雌激素样活性对S-AKI发挥保护作用尚不清楚。目的：本研究旨在通过体内和体外实验，探讨Fre D和Reh C通过雌激素受体通路对脂多糖（LPS）诱导的S-AKI的作用及机制，并首次探索ER与TLR4之间的相互作用。方法：通过添加雌激素受体拮抗剂ICI182,780，建立LPS诱导的雌性BALB/c小鼠S-AKI模型。检测肾功能、炎症、氧化应激、凋亡、免疫细胞以及ER-TLR4-IL-1β通路关键蛋白的表达。通过分子对接研究Fre D和Reh C与ER的亲和力。随后，建立体外S-AKI模型，添加ERα/ERβ拮抗剂（MPP/PHTPP），并结合基因过表达技术。通过Co-IP、GST pull-down和SPR技术进一步探索ER与TLR4之间的相互作用。结果：Fre D和Reh C改善了LPS诱导的小鼠肾损伤和炎症，调节了免疫细胞，降低了ROS水平，增加了ERα和ERβ蛋白表达，并降低了TLR4、caspase 11和IL-1β蛋白表达。这些效应被ICI182,780阻断。分子对接结果显示，Fre D和Reh C与ERα和ERβ的结合效力相似。体外实验结果表明，Fre D和Reh C降低了细胞中炎症、ROS和凋亡水平，以及TLR4、caspase 11和IL-1β蛋白表达，并增加了ERα/ERβ蛋白表达。所有这些效应均被MPP/PHTPP的添加所逆转，并在ERα/ERβ基因过表达后进一步增强，且效应无显著差异。此外，ER与TLR4之间存在直接或间接的相互作用，且ERα和ERβ与TLR4的结合呈浓度依赖性。结论：Fre D和Reh C可能通过ER-TLR4-IL-1β通路改善S-AKI，并可能同时作用于ERα和ERβ受体。此外，ERα和ERβ可能与TLR4直接或间接相互作用，这是首次研究。
